title: Instrumental Methods Of Analysis
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the energy that causes the rotation of a molecule."
Rotational spectroscopy is concerned with the energy that causes the rotation of a molecule.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the vibrations of molecules when photons of radiation are absorbed."
Vibrational spectroscopy is concerned with the vibrations of molecules when photons of radiation are absorbed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the elimination of the problems associated with the preparation, standardization and storage of standard solutions."
Among the advantages is the elimination of the problems associated with the preparation, standardization and storage of standard solutions.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the intersection of the two lines. • Acid-base titration As an acid is titrated with an alkali, the ionic composition of the mixture changes and this is reflected in the conductivity of the solution."

The end point is the intersection of the two lines. • Acid-base titration As an acid is titrated with an alkali, the ionic composition of the mixture changes and this is reflected in the conductivity of the solution.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as that concentration of an element in aqueous solution which absorbs 1% of the incident radiation passing through a cloud of atoms being determined."
Sensitivity is defined as that concentration of an element in aqueous solution which absorbs 1% of the incident radiation passing through a cloud of atoms being determined.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key heart to the operation of the interferometer."
The beam splitter is the key heart to the operation of the interferometer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the heart of a FTIR spectrophotometer."
An interferometer is the heart of a FTIR spectrophotometer.
fib: ______ are used for the detection of ultraviolet and visible radiations.
Photoelectric detectors
Photoelectric detectors are used for the detection of ultraviolet and visible radiations.
______ is a method which deals with the study of the interaction between x-ray radiation with matter.
X-ray spectroscopy
X-ray spectroscopy is a method which deals with the study of the interaction between x-ray radiation with matter.
______ is the cathode and the steady detachment of the drops minimizes contamination.
attached mercury drop
The attached mercury drop is the cathode and the steady detachment of the drops minimizes contamination.
______ is a photographic film or plate which will darken when exposed to x-rays.
simplest detector
The simplest detector is a photographic film or plate which will darken when exposed to x-rays.
______ is used to increase the conductivity because of large negative discharge potential of the potassium ion.
Potassium chloride electrolyte
Potassium chloride electrolyte is used to increase the conductivity because of large negative discharge potential of the potassium ion.
______ is the most satisfactory source of visible and near infrared radiation.
tungsten filament lamp
A tungsten filament lamp is the most satisfactory source of visible and near infrared radiation.

Hydrogen
Hydrogen is the most important element that displays NMR properties then followed by Carbon.
